items.title: US death row inmate survives execution attempt after two lethal injections
items.description: Killer Christa Pike's lawyer says she is being given "life-saving measures" in hospital after two syringes of pentobarbital.

items.title: Too early to say if Iran involved in Dubai-Tel Aviv flight attack, Israeli PM says
items.description: A pilot who stabbed another pilot on an Israel-bound plane is being investigated in Saudi Arabia, Benjamin Netanyahu says.

items.title: What we know about stabbing on Flydubai flight to Israel
items.description: A pilot has been arrested and is being questioned after another pilot was stabbed, officials say.

items.title: Rosenberg: Putin shows no sign of stopping the war as Russia doubles down on Ukraine
items.description: A foreign policy speech by the Russian president will be keenly watched, but all signs point to the full-scale invasion continuing.

items.title: Japan raises permanent residency fee by 20 times
items.description: The hikes are part of immigration policy changes introduced to manage Japan's growing foreign population.

items.title: Swiss glaciers suffer 'disastrous' year of ice loss, threatening water supplies
items.description: Scientists say such rapid melting is no longer surprising given the pace of climate change.

items.title: Tiny image sparks big backlash in Nikon photo contest
items.description: Dr Ning Xu denies he broke the rules of Nikon's annual Small World In Motion contest.

items.title: K-pop star convicted of violating military service law
items.description: The member of K-pop band Winner was given a suspended prison sentence for repeated absences from his national service work.

items.title: Zimbabwe tycoon Wicknell Chivayo and wife killed in helicopter crash
items.description: Chivayo was known for his lavish lifestyle, close ties to African presidents and lucrative government contracts.

items.title: Cornell case spotlights 'confusing' web of systems for reporting campus assaults
items.description: Victims often have to navigate both university and local law enforcement processes to find justice.

items.title: California bans child marriage, a practice still legal in 32 US states
items.description: Gov Gavin Newsom called it a "long overdue measure to protect young Californians".

items.title: Trekkers helicoptered off mountains as more deadly landslides hit Nepal
items.description: A month after mass catastrophic flooding, around 30 people have died in landslides and heavy rain.

items.title: Six smugglers jailed for manslaughter over worst Channel small boats disaster
items.description: Thirty-one migrants died when their boat went down in November 2021. The trial found that the guilty men were part of two smuggling networks.

items.title: Russia launches largest attack on Ukraine energy infrastructure since spring
items.description: In total 11 regions of the country were attacked overnight, with residential buildings and railways also targeted, the Ukrainian PM says.

items.title: Last UK and US troops leave Iraq as anti-Islamic State mission ends
items.description: The withdrawal of coalition forces, under a deal agreed two years ago, was a key demand of the Iraqi government.

items.title: Ethiopia fighting escalates in Tigray killing 52 civilians, medic tells the BBC
items.description: The deadly fighting has also spread to neighbouring regions, stranding tourists in Lalibela.

items.title: Girl has multiple surgeries to control infections after strike in Gaza
items.description: Witnesses say Raseel's tent was hit by an Israeli helicopter strike. Israel’s military says it has no record of the attack.

items.title: US actor Chad Lowe 'heartbroken' by death of daughter Fiona aged 13
items.description: Lowe and his wife Kim Painter announce the death of their daughter, who "was the light of our lives".

items.title: Chinese AI tool told researchers how to make bioweapons
items.description: Mindgard said it discovered in July that Kimi models K2.6 and K3 Swarm could evade developer's safety limits.

items.title: Singapore launches matchmaking service for government workers
items.description: The launch of FirstDate comes as the ageing nation wrestles with a record-low fertility rate.
